chunks: Ali ibn Muhammad, from some of our companions, said:

Muhammad ibn Hujr wrote to Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام), complaining about Abd al-Aziz ibn Dulaf and Yazid ibn Abd Allah. So he wrote to him: As for Abd al-Aziz, you have been spared him; and as for Yazid, then for you and for him there is a standing before Allah. Then Abd al-Aziz died, and Yazid killed Muhammad ibn Hujr.

key_terms.بَيْنَ يَدَيِ اللَّهِ: before Allah, in divine judgment or reckoning
key_terms.كُفِيتَهُ: you have been spared him or sufficed against him
key_terms.يَشْكُو: he complains or brings a grievance

ai.seo_question: What did Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) say when Muhammad ibn Hujr complained about Abd al-Aziz ibn Dulaf and Yazid ibn Abd Allah?
ai.summary: This report recounts that Muhammad ibn Hujr complained to Abu Muhammad (عليه السلام) about two men, and the Imam replied with distinct outcomes for each. The narration then records the realization of that reply, indicating foreknowledge of ensuing events and a coming reckoning before Allah.

en.hubeali: Ali Bin Muhammad, from some of our companions who said,

‘Muhammad Bin Hujr wrote to Abu Muhammad<sup>asws</sup> (11<sup>th</sup> Imam<sup>asws</sup>) complaining of Abdul Aziz Bin Dulf and Yazeed Bin Abdullah. So he<sup>asws</sup> wrote to him: ‘As for Abdul Aziz, So I shall suffice him<sup>asws</sup>, and as for Yazeed, so for you and for him there is a status in front of Allah<sup>azwj</sup>. So Abdul Aziz died and Yazeed killed Muhammad Bin Hujr’.
en.sarwar: 25. Ali ibn Muhammad has narrated from certain persons of our people who have narrated the following. “

mmd ibn al-Hujr once wrote to abu Muhammad (a.s.) complaining against ‘Abd al-‘Aziz ibn Dulf and Yazid ibn ‘Abdallah. He wrote back in reply, “As far as ‘Abd al-‘Aziz is concerned I have relieved you from his troubles. As far as Yazid is concerned for each of you there is position before Allah.” ‘Abd al-‘Aziz died and Yazid killed Muhammad ibn Hujr.”
